messages:
Rae: Hey runtime team — need a reproducible smoke + full-run for the 'demo-spark' cohort for next week's launch materials. Goal: validated latency & correctness artifacts we can hand to design and comms. Requirements:
- 1,000 samples split 40/40/20 (short/medium/long)
- Variants: fp16 baseline, int8 quant, and a rapid 4-bit probe (aq4)
- For each variant: per-sample token timings, p50/p95 (cold/warm), and a short sample-level diff against references
- Retain raw outputs + traces for 14 days
Priority: high. Can we get a smoke (200 samples) in 3h, full-run in 12h?

Tom: Copy. Drop the sample manifest and reference file into s3://redwood-internal/marketing/demo-spark/manifest.json. Which model and commit?

Rae: Model: redwood-serve/2.2-large@commit-6f7a2d. Run flags: --quantize=8 for int8, --quantize=4-probe for aq4. Seed: 2026-04-01. Cohort tag: demo-spark-launch.

Priya: Add me to any anomaly pings. Also would like a heatmap of latency vs prompt length for the slide. If 4-bit is noisy, mark examples where LM output diverged >0.2 similarity and flag for review.

Ops Bot: Scheduling jobs. If GPU resources constrained, will run fp16+int8 first, aq4 as lower priority probe.

Runtime Bot: Queued: job_fp16=run-20260401-9001, job_int8=run-20260401-9002, job_aq4=run-20260401-9003 (queued low priority). Smoke fallback: run-20260401-9000. Estimated full-run: ~10-14h depending on cluster. Artefact bucket: s3://redwood-internal/runs/run-20260401-9001/
